title: Three-Phase Separator
model_title: Horizontal Three-Phase Separator (Gas / Oil / Water) with Weir

introduction.definition: A three-phase separator splits well fluid into gas, oil and water. Gas rises; liquid settles into water below oil. Oil spills over a weir into a compartment; water is drawn from beneath the oil. Level and interface controllers set each outlet.
introduction.summary: A three-phase separator splits well fluid into gas, oil and water. Gas rises to the top; the liquid settles into a water layer below an oil layer. The oil spills over a weir into a separate compartment; water is drawn from under the oil. Interface and level controllers set each outlet.

script.narration: This module introduces the Three-Phase Separator.
A three-phase separator splits well fluid into gas, oil and water.
Gas rises; liquid settles into water below oil.
Oil spills over a weir into a compartment; water is drawn from beneath the oil.
Typical applications include oil & gas production; refinery desalter feed / slop oil; produced-water treatment front end.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: Three-Phase Separator — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Three-Phase Separator.
Check levels and interface.
Sand jetting/draining.
Inspect weir and internals.
Watch for oil in water outlet: oily produced water. Common cause: interface too low, emulsion.
Watch for water in oil: high bs&w. Common cause: short retention, emulsion.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
